segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so quick check on Northline Packaging. They're at 64 seats, services add-on is $9,800, target start date is February 3rd.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Okay. Are they still good with the 24-month term and annual billing?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: They are. The only hangup is I’ve nudged legal a couple times on the indemnity edit, and their procurement team won’t issue the PO until that answer comes back.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Got it. Is the buyer pushing, or are they calm?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Pretty calm. Also, I’m waiting on security to sign off on the data retention response. I’ve been poking them since Monday, because Northline’s IT lead won’t book the admin training until they have it.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: That makes sense. Pricing-wise, anything weird?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: No, standard discount, 11 percent. One more thing, deal desk has the order form held until finance confirms the split invoice language. I asked finance again this morning, since the customer wants the first invoice to land after February 1st.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Okay, sounds clean otherwise. Once those come back, send the order form and keep the close date at January 29th.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, that’s the plan. I’ll keep the buyer warm with the implementation calendar and not overcomplicate it.
